task: M2 WebView surface scan (offline, static). Scan Wikipedia + all corpus APKs for android.webkit.* call/override surface; order Wikipedia by the open-an-article path; count WebView keys and U13 lit/not-lit; give route-a (WebViewProvider->NWeb) an 'implement N methods -> cover X keys' table. Deliver surface.csv + README. cc cc-t3.
method: pure-Python DEX method_ids parser (recipe/scan_webview_surface.py): a method_id with class Landroid/webkit/* = a call into the WebView framework; curated callback names appearing as method_ids = app overrides. Handles .apk and .xapk inner base apk.
correctness_guard: android.webkit.MimeTypeMap.* and static WebView.findAddress/findAll are utilities that never instantiate a WebView (76 keys call only these). 'renders_webview' requires a real embed signal (WebView.<init>/loadUrl/setWebViewClient/getSettings/loadDataWithBaseURL/evaluateJavascript/addJavascriptInterface or extends WebViewClient/WebChromeClient).

wikipedia.article_first_paint_needs: construct + getSettings + WebSettings setters + setWebViewClient/setWebChromeClient + loadUrl/loadDataWithBaseURL + shouldInterceptRequest (serves bundled pagelib/CSS/JS offline)
wikipedia.note: wikipedia is LIT at t20 on its native onboarding (via M1), but the ARTICLE page renders in a WebView -> M2 is what makes article reading work

coverage.render_core_first_paint: 74/83 keys construct a WebView AND call a load method; core + each app's declared WebViewClient/WebChromeClient callbacks = first paint for ~all 83
coverage.finding: WebView apps have a long per-app tail (find-in-page, file chooser, HTTP-auth, zoom, print, download, geolocation); feature-complete coverage of all 83 needs ~617 methods -> target the render-core first, not full coverage

m2_targets.note_lit: 28 lit WebView keys render their native main screen (WebView secondary); EXCEPT wikipedia, lit on native shell but article page = WebView -> M2 lights article reading

this_rounds_rule: Scope a framework-backing effort by the method-reference surface and separate real embedders from utility callers (76 keys touch android.webkit only via MimeTypeMap/findAddress). The actionable M2 target is the render-core (12 methods) + per-app callbacks for first paint, not full API coverage (long per-app tail). 'lit' != 'needs no WebView': wikipedia is lit on its shell but its content screen is a WebView.
boundaries: Offline; static call/override references (not a runtime trace; reflection-invoked webkit would be missed, none seen); 'renders_webview' is a static predicate; lit/not-lit = u13-reference signing; PRIMARY/SECONDARY split uses app stack + cc-t3's confirmed web-wrapper set; secondary keys' own walls named from first-fatal clusters not re-measured. No board, no push.
